purpose: Bind serializable caller payload to a currently-ready response dispatch requirement profile without executing the destination authority or fabricating runtime handle bindings.

request_information.effect: records caller request data only; creates no ResolutionDiagnostic

validation: revision_key uses the same canonical validator as ResolutionRevisionChain.open_revision
revision chain root intent/revision/approval must match the evidence inbox target
an explicit parent revision must already be approved/compile-eligible
propose_revision.effect: records revision request payload only; does not call open_revision

reverify.reason: CompiledGraph, LayerRegistry, MathProgram, WasmTensor, and related runtime values must not be replaced by caller-supplied string identities

identity.request_fingerprint: fnv1a64 over ResponseIntent fingerprint + dispatch fingerprint + requirements fingerprint + selected action + canonical serialized request payload + ordered bound requirements + ordered explicitly-unbound optional requirements
identity.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not cryptographic integrity, authentication, authorization, or a capability token

checks: response intent fingerprint/action/evidence kind still match
dispatch fingerprint/authority/operation/executor contract/payload mode still match current projection
requirements fingerprint still matches current projection
request fingerprint still matches its payload, requirement-accounting lists, and current upstream projections
does_not_check: future mutable authority state after request creation

invariants: request creation never invokes a verifier
request creation never opens a revision
request creation never creates or submits a ResolutionDiagnostic
request creation never mutates Resolution state
request creation never treats an opaque string as a runtime graph/program/tensor handle
a closed or stale requirements projection cannot produce a request
every required dispatch requirement must be bound and every optional requirement must be explicitly bound or recorded unbound
request_fingerprint commits to the bound/unbound requirement accounting exported by the request
direct authority APIs remain independently callable escape hatches
executor-specific state must be revalidated again at the actual execution boundary
future_extensions: executor-specific runtime handle binding for reverify
execution receipt carrying request_fingerprint and dispatch_fingerprint
